name: catalyst_tps_foundation_r2e_v1
purpose: Improve TPS-specific R2E using enzyme-specialized foundation protein representations and mature reaction fingerprints without clean2023 association-label transfer.

split_semantics.reaction_cluster: legacy frozen TPS reaction grouping at 0.5 similarity
split_semantics.development_cells: the 9 Cartesian cells with protein_fold=4 OR reaction_fold=4
split_semantics.legacy_frozen_cells: the 16 Cartesian cells with protein_fold<4 AND reaction_fold<4

protein.enzgfm: EnzGFM-650M foundation embedding; exact-sequence reuse plus label-free encoding for missing rows
protein.equalblock: independently L2-normalized ESM-C and EnzGFM blocks concatenated

reaction.rdkitplus3139: same exact 2115-d base plus append-only Horizyn RDKit+ 1024-d structural block

development_evaluation.candidate_universe: all 1421 frozen v1.5 TPS protein entities

legacy_frozen_policy.required: selected development candidate must not regress MRR/MAP and should materially improve Hit@10 versus the strongest valid existing TPS specialist on identical support

next_external_if_legacy_passes: evaluate exactly once on CATALYST_TPS_TEMPORAL_R2E_V1 v2.1 temporal benchmark; temporal protein-cold is primary because preregistered strict-double-cold support was underpowered
